'''2009 US West Nationals Day 2 Ryan French LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Ryan French]] at [[2009 US West Nationals]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Quit Munching Cum
* '''Username:''' Shadow13
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
